To list your repositories, you can use the following API call:

```
GET /user/repos
```

This will return a list of repositories owned by the authenticated user.

Alternatively, you can use the `search_repositories` function with the `owner` parameter set to the authenticated user's username:

```
{
  "function": "search_repositories",
  "parameters": {
    "owner": "your_username",
    "query": ""
  }
}
```

Replace `your_username` with your actual GitHub username. This will return a list of repositories owned by you.
